"""Tests for the PNF normalizer (reduction/pnf.py)."""

import unittest

from reduction.grammar import Grammar, GrammarRule, RuleType
from reduction.pnf import (
    PNFNormalizer,
    find_recursive_rules,
    python_pnf_grammar,
    reachable_rules,
    to_pnf,
)


class TestUnreachableElimination(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_drops_rules_not_reachable_from_start(self):
        g = Grammar(start_symbol="s")
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("s", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["A", "B"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("A", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["TOKEN_a", "TOKEN_b"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("B", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["TOKEN_c", "TOKEN_d"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("orphan", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["TOKEN_x", "TOKEN_y"]))

        norm = PNFNormalizer()
        out = norm.normalize(g)

        self.assertNotIn("orphan", out.rules)
        self.assertIn("orphan", norm.stats.removed_unreachable)
        self.assertIn("s", out.rules)

    def test_reachable_rules_includes_start(self):
        g = Grammar(start_symbol="s")
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("s", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["A", "TOKEN_z"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("A", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["TOKEN_a", "TOKEN_b"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("dead", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["TOKEN_q", "TOKEN_r"]))
        self.assertEqual(reachable_rules(g), {"s", "A"})

    def test_input_grammar_is_not_mutated(self):
        g = Grammar(start_symbol="s")
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("s", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["A", "B"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("A", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["TOKEN_a", "TOKEN_b"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("B", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["TOKEN_c", "TOKEN_d"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("orphan", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["TOKEN_x", "TOKEN_y"]))
        before = set(g.rules)
        to_pnf(g)
        self.assertEqual(set(g.rules), before)


class TestSingleAlternativeInlining(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_single_symbol_rule_is_inlined(self):
        g = Grammar(start_symbol="s")
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("s", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["wrapper", "TOKEN_end"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("wrapper", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["real"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("real", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["TOKEN_a", "TOKEN_b"]))

        norm = PNFNormalizer()
        out = norm.normalize(g)

        self.assertNotIn("wrapper", out.rules)
        self.assertIn("wrapper", norm.stats.inlined_rules)
        self.assertEqual(out.rules["s"].symbols, ["real", "TOKEN_end"])

    def test_chain_of_wrappers_is_fully_inlined(self):
        g = Grammar(start_symbol="s")
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("s", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["a", "TOKEN_end"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("a", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["b"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("b", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["c"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("c", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["TOKEN_x", "TOKEN_y"]))

        out = to_pnf(g)
        self.assertEqual(out.rules["s"].symbols, ["c", "TOKEN_end"])
        self.assertNotIn("a", out.rules)
        self.assertNotIn("b", out.rules)

    def test_start_symbol_is_never_inlined(self):
        g = Grammar(start_symbol="s")
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("s", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["body"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("body", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["TOKEN_a", "TOKEN_b"]))
        out = to_pnf(g)
        self.assertIn("s", out.rules)

    def test_quantified_rules_are_not_inlined(self):
        g = Grammar(start_symbol="s")
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("s", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["items", "TOKEN_end"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("items", RuleType.KLEENE_STAR, ["item"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("item", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["TOKEN_a", "TOKEN_b"]))
        out = to_pnf(g)
        self.assertIn("items", out.rules)
        self.assertEqual(out.rules["items"].rule_type, RuleType.KLEENE_STAR)


class TestRecursionRemoval(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_direct_left_recursion_in_sequence(self):
        g = Grammar(start_symbol="expr")
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("expr", RuleType.SEQUENCE,
                               ["expr", "OPERATOR_plus", "term"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("term", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["TOKEN_num"]))

        norm = PNFNormalizer()
        out = norm.normalize(g)

        self.assertIn("expr", norm.stats.recursion_eliminated)
        self.assertFalse(PNFNormalizer._is_directly_recursive(out, "expr"))
        self.assertEqual(norm.validate(out), [])

    def test_direct_right_recursion_in_sequence(self):
        g = Grammar(start_symbol="chain")
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("chain", RuleType.SEQUENCE,
                               ["item", "DELIMITER_comma", "chain"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("item", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["TOKEN_a", "TOKEN_b"]))

        norm = PNFNormalizer()
        out = norm.normalize(g)
        self.assertIn("chain", norm.stats.recursion_eliminated)
        self.assertFalse(PNFNormalizer._is_directly_recursive(out, "chain"))

    def test_alternation_left_recursion_becomes_kleene(self):
        g = Grammar(start_symbol="expr")
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("expr", RuleType.ALTERNATION,
                               ["expr_binop", "atom"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("expr_binop", RuleType.SEQUENCE,
                               ["expr", "op", "atom"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("atom", RuleType.ALTERNATION,
                               ["TOKEN_num", "TOKEN_id"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("op", RuleType.ALTERNATION,
                               ["OPERATOR_plus", "OPERATOR_minus"]))

        norm = PNFNormalizer()
        out = norm.normalize(g)

        self.assertIn("expr", norm.stats.recursion_eliminated)
        # A Kleene rule over the recursion tail must now exist.
        self.assertTrue(any(r.rule_type == RuleType.KLEENE_STAR
                            for r in out.rules.values()))
        self.assertFalse(PNFNormalizer._is_directly_recursive(out, "expr"))

    def test_self_alternative_is_dropped(self):
        g = Grammar(start_symbol="a")
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("a", RuleType.ALTERNATION, ["a", "b", "c"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("b", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["TOKEN_b1", "TOKEN_b2"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("c", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["TOKEN_c1", "TOKEN_c2"]))

        norm = PNFNormalizer()
        out = norm.normalize(g)
        self.assertNotIn("a", [s for s in out.rules["a"].symbols])

    def test_indirect_recursion_is_preserved(self):
        # statement -> if_stmt -> block -> statement models real nesting and
        # must survive normalization.
        g = Grammar.python_simplified()
        out = to_pnf(g)
        cycles = find_recursive_rules(out)
        self.assertTrue(cycles, "expected indirect nesting cycles to remain")
        self.assertIn("block", out.rules)


class TestQuantifiedRuleHandling(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_inline_quantifier_is_factored_into_named_rule(self):
        inline = GrammarRule("", RuleType.KLEENE_STAR, ["arg"])
        g = Grammar(start_symbol="call")
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("call", RuleType.SEQUENCE,
                               ["name", "DELIMITER_lparen", inline,
                                "DELIMITER_rparen"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("arg", RuleType.SEQUENCE,
                               ["TOKEN_a", "TOKEN_b"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("name", RuleType.SEQUENCE,
                               ["TOKEN_id1", "TOKEN_id2"]))

        norm = PNFNormalizer()
        out = norm.normalize(g)

        self.assertTrue(norm.stats.factored_quantifiers)
        for rule in out.rules.values():
            for sym in rule.symbols:
                self.assertIsInstance(sym, str)
        self.assertIn("arg_star", out.rules)
        self.assertEqual(out.rules["arg_star"].rule_type, RuleType.KLEENE_STAR)

    def test_repetition_run_becomes_kleene_plus(self):
        g = Grammar(start_symbol="triple")
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("triple", RuleType.SEQUENCE,
                               ["item", "item", "item", "TOKEN_end"]))
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("item", RuleType.SEQUENCE,
                               ["TOKEN_a", "TOKEN_b"]))

        norm = PNFNormalizer()
        out = norm.normalize(g)

        self.assertTrue(norm.stats.quantified_repetitions)
        self.assertIn("item_plus", out.rules)
        self.assertEqual(out.rules["item_plus"].rule_type, RuleType.KLEENE_PLUS)
        self.assertEqual(out.rules["triple"].symbols, ["item_plus", "TOKEN_end"])

    def test_quantified_rules_have_exactly_one_symbol(self):
        out = python_pnf_grammar()
        for rule in out.rules.values():
            if rule.is_quantified():
                self.assertEqual(len(rule.symbols), 1, rule.name)


class TestPythonGrammarNormalization(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_result_is_pnf_and_validates(self):
        norm = PNFNormalizer(Grammar.python_simplified())
        out = norm.normalize()
        self.assertTrue(out.is_pnf())
        self.assertEqual(norm.validate(out), [])

    def test_stats_record_work(self):
        norm = PNFNormalizer(Grammar.python_simplified())
        norm.normalize()
        self.assertGreater(norm.stats.total_changes(), 0)
        self.assertTrue(norm.stats.inlined_rules)
        self.assertIn('inlined_rules', norm.stats.as_dict())

    def test_essential_rules_survive(self):
        out = python_pnf_grammar()
        for essential in ("program", "block", "if_stmt", "for_stmt",
                          "func_def", "class_def", "try_stmt"):
            self.assertIn(essential, out.rules)

    def test_program_stays_kleene_star(self):
        out = python_pnf_grammar()
        self.assertEqual(out.rules["program"].rule_type, RuleType.KLEENE_STAR)

    def test_normalize_requires_a_grammar(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            PNFNormalizer().normalize()

    def test_validate_flags_a_non_pnf_grammar(self):
        g = Grammar(start_symbol="s")
        g.add_rule(GrammarRule("s", RuleType.SEQUENCE, ["s", "TOKEN_x"]))
        self.assertTrue(PNFNormalizer().validate(g))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

"""Tests for the Perses reducer (reduction/perses_reducer.py)."""

import unittest

from reduction.config import Config
from reduction.driver import ReductionDriver
from reduction.grammar import Grammar
from reduction.parser import Parser
from reduction.perses_reducer import (
    NodePriorityQueue,
    PersesReducer,
    is_ancestor,
    iter_all_nodes,
    parent_map,
    replace_node_content,
    restore_deletions,
    snapshot_deletions,
    token_nodes,
)
from reduction.pnf import python_pnf_grammar
from reduction.reducer import AbstractReducer
from reduction.tree import NodeType, SparTreeNode


class FakeTester:
    """Property tester stand-in driven by a predicate over the source text."""

    def __init__(self, predicate):
        self.predicate = predicate
        self._test_count = 0

    @property
    def test_count(self):
        return self._test_count

    def test(self, source):
        self._test_count += 1
        return self.predicate(source)

    def reset_count(self):
        self._test_count = 0


GRAMMAR = python_pnf_grammar()


def parse(source):
    return Parser(GRAMMAR).parse(source)


class TestTreeHelpers(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tree = parse("a = 1\nb = 2\nc = 3\n")

    def test_iter_all_nodes_includes_deleted(self):
        total = len(iter_all_nodes(self.tree))
        self.tree.children[0].delete()
        self.assertEqual(len(iter_all_nodes(self.tree)), total)
        self.assertLess(len(self.tree.all_nodes()), total)

    def test_snapshot_restore_is_exact(self):
        self.tree.children[0].delete()
        snap = snapshot_deletions(self.tree)
        self.tree.children[1].delete()
        restore_deletions(self.tree, snap)
        self.assertTrue(self.tree.children[0].deleted)
        self.assertFalse(self.tree.children[1].deleted)

    def test_restore_rejects_shape_change(self):
        snap = snapshot_deletions(self.tree)
        self.tree.children.pop()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            restore_deletions(self.tree, snap)
